task: Apply CSF (Cloth Simulation Filter) ground segmentation to /home/user/Documents/scene.ply (2500 points, ASCII). Classify points into ground and non-ground using default CSF parameters. Export only the ground points as an ASCII PLY at /home/user/Documents/ground.ply. The output should contain only points classified as ground.
task_grounding: Open /home/user/Documents/scene.ply in CloudCompare. It is an ASCII PLY with 2500 points: ~1500 points forming a gently-sloped ground plane (Z near 0-1) and ~1000 elevated points representing objects above the ground (Z in roughly 3-8). Use the CSF (Cloth Simulation Filter) plugin (Plugins > CSF Filter, or Tools > Segmentation > CSF Filter, depending on the build) with default parameters to separate ground points from off-ground points. Select the resulting ground-points cloud and export it as an ASCII PLY at /home/user/Documents/ground.ply. Do not export the off-ground cloud and do not export the original scene. The ground output must have between 1000 and 2000 points and its bounding box must lie within Z in [-1, 2.5] (i.e., only ground-level points).

cli_feasibility.translation: Use CloudCompare CLI: cli-anything-cloudcompare export cloud INDEX output.ply --preset ply [--overwrite]
cli_feasibility.reason: CLI has 'export cloud' command supporting multiple formats (PLY binary/ASCII, LAS, XYZ, etc.) with format-specific options.
